build_check.description: index.html and game_logic.js exist, a canvas/WebGL renderer is present, and no disallowed heavy runtime asset references are used.

requirements.description: Holding the attract button pulls the player toward the nearest metal surface with increasing acceleration. The pull is visible as a trajectory line or particle stream connecting player to anchor. Releasing at speed converts pull into ballistic momentum. Score 0 if no magnetic attract mechanic exists.

Pressing repel near a metal surface launches the player away at high speed in the opposite direction. The repel provides explosive force for crossing gaps and ascending shafts. Score 0 if no repel mechanic exists.

Metal surfaces are clearly marked in the environment and serve as anchor points for both attract and repel. Non-metal surfaces do not respond to magnetic abilities. The distinction is visually clear. Score 0 if no metal/non-metal distinction exists.

Levels require chaining attract and repel moves to traverse — swinging from one anchor, releasing into free flight, then catching another anchor or repelling off a surface. Momentum chains are the primary traversal method. Score 0 if levels can be completed with basic jumping alone.

Boss fights (at least 2) take place in arenas with metal anchors and require using magnetic mechanics offensively — deflecting projectiles with repel or pulling away boss armor with attract. Score 0 if no boss encounters exist.

At least 15 levels across 3 zones are present, each with unique arrangements of metal anchors, hazards, and traversal challenges. Levels within a zone share a theme but vary in layout. Score 0 if fewer than 8 levels exist.

Hazards specific to the magnetic theme exist: electric fields that damage on contact, crushers that activate near metal, moving metal platforms that shift anchor points, and demagnetized zones where abilities fail. At least 3 distinct hazard types. Score 0 if no hazards exist beyond pits.
Three zones with distinct visual themes and escalating complexity. Each zone introduces new level elements or hazard combinations. A boss caps each zone. Score 0 if only one zone exists.

Collectibles in levels reward stylish momentum chains — placed in locations only reachable through skilled attract/repel sequences. A style rating based on momentum chains and collectibles is awarded per level. Score 0 if no collectibles or rating exists.
Level completion shows time, collectibles, and style rating. A zone-select screen shows progress per zone. Boss defeat unlocks the next zone. Score 0 if no completion tracking exists.
A styled title screen shows the robot character suspended between magnets with the game name. A zone-select menu is accessible. Score 0 if the game starts directly in gameplay or uses raw default UI.
The game flow connects title -> zone select -> levels -> boss -> next zone without restarting. Score 0 if transitions are missing.

During gameplay, magnetic connection lines or particle streams are visible when attract/repel is active. Metal surfaces glow or pulse to indicate interactability. The HUD shows boss health during fights. Score 0 if no visual feedback for magnetic mechanics exists.
Readability at 1280x720 is strong: metal surfaces, non-metal surfaces, hazards, the player, and magnetic effects are all clearly distinguishable. Score 0 if elements blend together.

The art direction is coherent across title, zones, robot, magnetic effects, and UI — a consistent industrial/sci-fi aesthetic with metallic palette and energy effects. Score 0 if mostly default UI or mismatched placeholders dominate. Full credit may be earned with runtime-authored procedural textures, layered materials, deliberate multi-light rigs, particles, synthesized audio, or post-processing; external asset files are not required.

Environments use real sprite or tile art for metal surfaces, walls, hazards, and backgrounds — not plain ColorRect fills. Different zones have visually distinct industrial themes. Score 0 if environments are uniform color fills.
HUD and UI chrome: zone select, level complete, boss health bar, and style rating use styled themed widgets — not raw unstyled HTML 引擎 defaults. Score 0 if primary UI elements are obviously unstyled.

Animation and feedback: attract shows energy streams, repel produces a shockwave burst, momentum chains leave speed trails, metal surfaces pulse when in range, and boss hits produce impact effects. Score 0 if all state changes snap silently.
